# Plugged In Electric

> Plugged In Electric is a full-service electrical contractor in Tucson, AZ offering residential and commercial electrical services including troubleshooting, panel upgrades, EV charger installation, and lighting solutions.

Based in Tucson, Arizona, Plugged In Electric specializes in both residential and commercial electrical work, from routine maintenance and repairs to major upgrades like panel replacements and EV charger installations. The company serves the Tucson and Vail areas with comprehensive electrical diagnostics and safety-focused solutions.
